question_text: Outline why neither StudentID nor ModuleID alone identifies an enrollment record uniquely when each student can take many modules and each module has many students. Assume one enrollment per student-module pair, with no repeat attempts.
adaptation_rationale: Composite keys explicit. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: A student appears in multiple enrollments and a module has multiple students; the pair(StudentID, ModuleID)uniquely identifies one enrollment when repeat attempts are not allowed.
